stories.title: Farage wins uncontested U.K. by-election as funding probe restarts
new_facts: Count Binface finished second in the Clacton by-election.
Farage won with 62.8% of the vote; donor named as Christopher Harborne; donation figure is £5 million; Farage missed the count citing a threat.
Farage called the by-election explicitly in protest at parliamentary and media scrutiny of his finances.
Turnout was ~10,000 fewer than the general election two years ago.
If the standards probe goes against Farage, a second Clacton by-election could be triggered.
Farage wins the Clacton by-election and returns to UK parliament.
Electoral watchdog has reopened investigation into Farage's £5m gift after election win.
Farage received over 22,000 votes; Count Binface received under 10,000 votes.
Count Binface took over a quarter of the vote (more than 25%).
Farage received 22,239 votes; Count Binface received 9,455 votes.
Only two of 34 candidates secured enough votes to reclaim their deposit; one candidate got seven votes.
stories.line: Farage wins a U.K. by-election he called himself in a seat major parties boycotted, as a financial probe into his campaign funding resumes.

stories.title: NATO shoots down drone over Latvia in eastern Europe
new_facts: An Italian NATO fighter jet specifically shot down the drone over Latvia.
Latvia attributes the drone incursion to Russian electromagnetic warfare.
A foreign drone entered Latvian airspace; NATO jets scrambled; Finland temporarily restricts airspace.
NATO jets shot down the drone over Latvia; it was not merely scrambled against.
Drone was described as a kamikaze drone and crossed near Latvia's border with Russia.
stories.line: NATO shot down a drone over Latvia; Latvia attributes it to Russian electromagnetic warfare.

Hegseth claims US Navy can sustain an indefinite blockade against Iran despite poor ship conditions.
